movies.d: Two prisoners build an unlikely friendship over decades and hold onto hope behind bars.
A masked vigilante faces an anarchic criminal mastermind who pushes Gotham to its breaking point.
A thief who steals secrets from people’s dreams gets one last job: planting an idea instead.
A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook drifts through decades of history, always loving one woman.
An old man reads a love story to a woman, the tale of two young lovers separated by class.
Two best friends chase one wild, chaotic night of parties before they graduate and go separate ways.
A young photographer visits his girlfriend’s family and slowly realizes something is deeply wrong.
A girl wanders into a spirit world and must work in a bathhouse to save her parents.
In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel warrior race across the sands to escape a tyrant.
An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.
Astronauts travel through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity as Earth fades.
A legendary concierge and his young lobby boy get tangled up in a stolen painting and a family fortune.
A poor family schemes its way into a wealthy household, with consequences nobody expected.
A music-loving boy enters the Land of the Dead to uncover his family’s secret.
A driven young drummer is pushed to his limits by a ruthless music teacher.
A professor travels to Singapore with her boyfriend and meets his extremely wealthy family.
Passengers fight to survive on a speeding train as a zombie outbreak sweeps across South Korea.
Two teenagers mysteriously swap bodies and try to find each other across time and distance.
Paranormal investigators help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse.
A detective investigates the death of a famous novelist whose entire family has a motive.
Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and meets other versions of the hero from across dimensions.
Four sisters grow up, chase their dreams and navigate love and family in 19th-century New England.
A cowboy doll feels threatened when a flashy space ranger becomes his owner’s new favorite toy.
A struggling comedian is pushed to the edge by a cold, uncaring city in this dark character study.
A Filipino worker in Hong Kong falls for a bartender, and both must weigh love against their futures.
The surviving heroes assemble one last time to undo a cosmic disaster and bring back those who vanished.
A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father's death, then must return to claim his place.
A young artist and a wealthy passenger fall in love aboard the doomed ocean liner on its maiden voyage.
A betrayed Roman general is forced into the arena and sets out to avenge his family.
A hacker discovers that his everyday world is a simulation and joins a rebellion against its machines.
An anxious clownfish crosses the ocean to find his missing son, helped by a forgetful blue tang.
The aging head of a crime family hands his empire to his reluctant youngest son.
Hitmen, a boxer and a gangster's wife cross paths in interlocking tales of crime in Los Angeles.
An orphan boy learns he is a wizard and starts his first year at a school of magic.
movies.t: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

movies.d: A young hobbit and eight companions set out to destroy a ring that could doom the world.
movies.t: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

movies.d: A fearless princess sets off to find her sister, whose icy powers have trapped their kingdom in winter.
A lonely widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies off on an adventure with an unexpected stowaway.
Inside a girl's mind, her emotions try to guide her through a big move to a new city.
A former marine is sent to a lush alien moon and finds himself torn between two worlds.
The new king of a hidden, high-tech African nation must defend his throne and his people.
An overwhelmed laundromat owner is pulled into a wild adventure across the multiverse.
A veteran test pilot trains a team of young graduates for a nearly impossible mission.
The story of the scientist who led the creation of the first atomic bomb and the weight that followed.
A doll living in a perfect pink world sets out for the real world after an identity crisis.
A gifted young heir travels to a dangerous desert planet to protect his family and its future.
A family must live in total silence to hide from creatures that hunt by sound.
After a family loss, a mother discovers disturbing secrets about her ancestry.
A farmhand sets out to rescue his true love in this fairy-tale adventure full of sword fights and wit.
A spirited island girl sails across the ocean with a demigod to save her people.
A middle-school music teacher finds new meaning in life after a fall lands his soul in another realm.
Two heartbroken strangers meet by chance and set off on a journey together that slowly turns into something more.
In Sapporo, a Filipina tour guide who has lost her sight forms a bond with a kind-hearted countryman.
A fiery general fights to unite a divided army during the Philippine-American War.
Four sisters reunite when their brother announces his wedding, and old family wounds resurface.
A young hat maker is cursed by a witch and finds refuge in a wizard's walking castle.
A teenager is accidentally sent back to 1955 and must make sure his parents fall in love so he can exist.
A theme park of cloned dinosaurs goes wrong when the security systems fail and the guests become prey.
A farm boy joins a smuggler, a rebel princess and a wise old knight to fight a galaxy-wide empire.
A businessman in wartime Poland risks everything to save more than a thousand Jewish workers.
An insomniac office worker and a reckless soap salesman start an underground club that spirals out of control.
Two detectives hunt a serial killer who bases each crime on one of the seven deadly sins.
A young FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned genius killer to catch another murderer.
A young man rises through the ranks of the mob and slowly watches the lifestyle unravel.
A janitor with a genius mind at MIT is guided by a therapist to face his past and his potential.
A struggling salesman and his young son face homelessness while he chases a chance at a better life.
A homeschooled new student learns the hard way how brutal high school cliques can be.
Three friends wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory and a missing groom.
A maid of honor’s life unravels as she competes with a rival while planning her best friend’s wedding.
Elizabeth Bennet clashes with the proud Mr. Darcy in a slow-burning romance in Regency England.
A wealthy businessman hires a street-smart woman for a week and neither expects to fall in love.
A teenager at a family resort falls for the resort’s dance instructor over one unforgettable summer.
An ambitious dreamer builds a spectacular circus show out of performers the world had overlooked.
On a Greek island, a bride-to-be invites three possible fathers to her wedding without telling her mother.
A bookish girl befriends a cursed prince and the enchanted objects in his castle.
A street thief finds a magic lamp and a fast-talking genie that could win him a princess.
A rat with a gift for cooking teams up with a young kitchen worker in a famous Paris restaurant.
A lonely trash-collecting robot on an empty Earth follows a sleek probe robot into space.
A Viking teen who is supposed to slay dragons befriends one instead and changes his village forever.
A clumsy, noodle-loving panda is unexpectedly chosen to become the legendary Dragon Warrior.
A grumpy ogre sets out to rescue a princess so he can get his swamp back.
Two sisters move to the countryside and meet the gentle forest spirits living nearby.
A young warrior gets caught between forest gods and the humans who are destroying their home.
A young demon slayer and his friends board a train where a terrifying demon is feeding on passengers.
A former bully tries to make amends with the deaf classmate he once tormented.
A runaway teen meets a girl who can control the weather in a rain-soaked Tokyo.
A teenage girl volunteers to take her sister’s place in a televised fight to the death.
A blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate to rescue his love from a cursed crew.
movies.t: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

movies.d: Archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis to find the legendary Ark of the Covenant.
James Bond investigates an attack on MI6 and faces an enemy from the agency’s own past.
A retired hitman comes out of hiding to take revenge on those who wronged him.
Ethan Hunt and his team race against time after a mission goes wrong and dangerous weapons are at stake.
A U.S. Marshal investigates a patient’s disappearance from a hospital for the criminally insane.
A man becomes the prime suspect when his wife vanishes on their wedding anniversary.
A child psychologist tries to help a frightened boy who says he can see people who don’t know they’re dead.
A group of outcast kids band together to face a shape-shifting evil that takes the form of a clown.
A family tries to save their comatose son from dark spirits that follow him from another realm.
A loving father with an intellectual disability is jailed for a crime he did not commit, and his daughter fights to see him.
A professor adopts a loyal dog who keeps waiting for him at the train station every day.
A 70-year-old widower becomes a senior intern at a fashion startup and bonds with its young founder.
A man whose marriage is falling apart gets dating lessons from a smooth-talking bachelor.
Years after their last goodbye, two Filipino lovers meet again in Canada and must face what they left unsaid.
A heartbroken man and his best friend share a quiet journey of feelings in the streets of Barcelona.
After a long relationship ends, a young man and woman each struggle to move on and to learn what real love means.
